- DPA annex compliance and whether Redwood accepts controller-to-processor DPA wording;

Hi all — Karthik here (serving/runtime infra). Below are concise answers and pointers to attached artifacts. Happy to expand on any bullet.

- Cross-border transfers: Redwood supports transfers using EU Standard Contractual Clauses, and where customers require additional safeguards we offer a DPF/annex playbook. We operate regionally pin-able model endpoints and can restrict processing to a customer-selected region (VPC/Private).
- Technical safeguards: all network traffic between control plane and inference nodes is TLS 1.3; at-rest model artifacts and customer data in our private mode are encrypted with customer-managed KMS where requested.
- KV cache and routing: we maintain per-tenant KV caches. For Hosted customers we may route requests across regions for capacity reasons; Dedicated and Private customers can be pinned to a region/cluster to avoid cross-border routing. See attached kvcache-routing-architecture-diagram.png.
- Logging & retention: request/response metadata and audit logs are retained according to the applicable contract — default 90 days for Hosted, configurable for Dedicated/Private. We provide exportable logs for compliance audits (CSV/JSON). Sample mapping in dpflow-map.csv.
- Subprocessors: we maintain a public subprocessors page; we will include the most recent snapshot in the evidence pack.

If Northbridge would like an explicit statement of where ephemeral tokens and cached content may traverse, we can provide a short technical attestation.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Serving Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Attachments: kvcache-routing-architecture-diagram.png (png), dpflow-map.csv (csv)

Hi Lauren / Olga,

Thanks for looping me in. A few legal points and next actions:

- DPA Annex: we will provide a draft annex (attached) that incorporates SCCs where applicable. Please note exceptions we typically highlight: SOC scope for hosted telemetry and third-party subprocessor rights.
- Controller/Processor: Redwood acts as a processor for inference workloads; for analytics or telemetry services we can outline separate processing activities in a schedule.
- Redlines: I’ve added an inline comment list in the DocuSign draft (link below). If Northbridge has preferred contract language beyond SCCs (e.g., EU-US DPF appendix), please upload your template and we’ll work it.

Proposed deliverables by 2029-04-18 EOD: consolidated evidence PDF, draft DPA annex (Docx) and a short compliance attestation letter.
